description: In-process IP intelligence for .NET: with a Premium svirfd.com key the whole index runs inside your own process, so any IPv4 or IPv6 lookup is a memory read in microseconds, with no network call, no rate limit and no address leaving your servers. Without a key the same client calls the svirfd.com API, which has a free tier. IP geolocation, ASN lookup, BGP routing with RPKI validity, and VPN, Tor and cloud-provider detection in one record, every field naming its public source and confidence. Live delta updates, an offline folder mode, immutable C# records with nullable annotations, and a plain-English narrative for every record. For .NET 8, 9 and 10.
releaseNotes: 0.0.3: a failed or refused start no longer fails or silences a host. UPGRADE NOTE: feed format 4 carries city coordinates for the time zone; a 0.0.2 client refuses a format 4 feed ("newer than this package understands"), so update before the service publishes it. Resilience: in Auto mode a failed snapshot download at start (429, 5xx, unreachable, timeout) now falls back to the API and retries Local in the background with backoff (Retry-After honoured), switching when the snapshot loads; a key the feed refuses (401, 403) stays on the API. An explicit Mode.Local still throws. SvirfdOptions.CacheDirectory (off by default) keeps the downloaded snapshot on disk so a restart loads it and fetches only the changes since, with no 75 MB download and no 429, and keeps answering while the feed is down. SvirfdOptions.BackgroundStart lets StartAsync return at once and load behind it (WaitUntilReadyAsync waits); LocalRetryPause and StaleAfter tune the retry and the stale threshold. Typed errors: SvirfdRateLimitedException, SvirfdUnauthorizedException and SvirfdUnavailableException, all derived from SvirfdException (itself an HttpRequestException, so existing catches keep working), with Reason and RetryAfter. State: client.State (Starting, Remote, LocalReady, FellBackToRemote, Stale, Failed), StateChanged, Staleness, LastError and NextRetryAt; a failed poll keeps serving the last good index. Tracking: every request now carries User-Agent: Svirfd-dotnet/<version>, and SvirfdOptions.Application appends your own name (Application = "Jube" sends Svirfd-dotnet/0.0.3-Jube) so the service logs can tell your traffic apart. Record: a new timezone block (IANA id and basis) for comparing with a visitor's browser zone, from the tz database; null when the country has several zones and no city is known, or for anycast. Cloudflare's WARP egress ranges are now reported as a relay (privacy.relay true, service "Cloudflare WARP") with a medium-confidence city. 0.0.2: repackaged with the corrected licence file and build scripts; the library's API and behaviour are unchanged from 0.0.1. 0.0.1, the first release, for .NET 8, 9 and 10. SvirfdClient with Auto, Remote, Local and Directory modes: the whole index in your process with live deltas, or the API, or a folder of files for a machine with no internet. The full record for any IPv4 or IPv6 address (registry, routing with RPKI, ASN, network type, VPN, Tor and relay lists, cloud region, location with its source and confidence, ping density), record.Narrate() for a plain-English explanation, and an XML documentation file for IntelliSense. One SvirfdClient per process: register it as a singleton (see Svirfd.Extensions.Hosting) or construct it once. https://svirfd.com/dotnet-ip-geolocation
title: Svirfd: In-Process IP Intelligence for .NET (IP Geolocation, ASN, VPN Detection)
